In the upcoming game, scheduled for October 16, 2026
If Eintracht Frankfurt wins, this market will resolve to "Yes".
Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve "No".
This market refers only to the outcome within the first 90 minutes of regular play plus stoppage time.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, data from Flashscore may be used; if Flashscore data is unavailable, data from Sofascore may be used; if neither is available, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead. All markets will settle based on the official final result as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. Revisions to officially declared final scores made after market resolution will not be accounted for in determining the outcome. If no acceptable data is available within 24 hours of the event's conclusion, this market will resolve 50-50, or to "Draw" where applicable.

In the upcoming NFL football game between Texans and Jaguars, scheduled for October 18 at 9:30AM ET:
This market will resolve to "Texans" if Texans win the game.
This market will resolve to "Jaguars" if Jaguars win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

files.body:
# garden/v5's module path. Deploy status is deliberately NOT recorded here -- see garden/v2's
# own gnomod.toml for why ("NOT deployed" written in this exact spot was deployed hours later
# and now lies on chain forever). NOT DEPLOYED as of the commit adding this file; deployment is
# a separate owner decision after reading the audit (2026-10-15 brief).
#
# Checklist before ever deploying, full detail in garden.gno's package doc and gnomod.toml's
# git history: (0) re-confirm the three sale constants, carried over from v4 as placeholders;
# (1) adminAddress is the onyx deploy key `gnotchi-deploy`, which is also this namespace -- it is
# funded (admin calls cost fees, and v4's old key is dust), but it is still a testnet key whose
# mnemonic sits on this host, so change it for anywhere real; (2) this
# realm imports the beacon/v2 drand verifier and cannot deploy where that path is not live;
# (3) numEyes/numNoses/hat/coat catalogue must match the art side exactly; (4) batchCap and the
# three named editions (hob/thistle/wick) are BATCH-ONE.md's roster, re-read it; (5) lockCaredDays
# is the owner's RECOMMENDATION, not yet confirmed; (6) genesisGnomeName is an unconfirmed
# placeholder. MUST NOT use the arcade/... prefix (ARCADE.md 4.7, NOTES.md).
module = "gno.land/r/g1nq99m3h9ed7vqve6ajpr3qwy2ls252m8jnundm/garden/v5"
gno = "0.9"
